data.name: Farhanah
data.gender_notes: Farhanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'farhana', which means 'to be joyful, content, or delighted'. This name is often given to a baby girl who is believed to bring happiness and joy to her parents and family. The name Farhanah carries the meaning “Joyful, content, delighted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farhanah usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, content, delighted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner peace and contentment
data.etymology: Farhanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, content, delighted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farhanah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فرحانة
in_arabic.meaning: فرحانة تعني الفرح والسرور والابتهاج في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فرحانة مشتق من الفعل فرح، والذي يعني الفرح والسرور والابتهاج. ورد ذكر الفعل فرح في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وفرحوا بما عندهم من العلم' (سورة آل عمران: 67). يعتبر اسم فرحانة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية وروحية، ويتماشى مع القيم الإسلامية التي تشجع على الفرح والسرور في الحياة

in_urdu.name: فرحانہ
in_urdu.meaning: فرحانہ کا مطلب ہے خوشی، مسرت اور خوش حالی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرحانہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو فعل فرح سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خوشی، مسرت اور خوش حالی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ قرآن کریم میں فرح کے مختلف پہلوؤں کا ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ فرحانہ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان ایک مقبول نام ہے، جو positive معنی اور روحانی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़रहानہ
in_hindi.meaning: फ़रहानہ का अर्थ है खुशी, आनंद और हर्ष
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़रहानah एक अरबी नाम है जो फ़رح क्रिया से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है खुशी, आनंद और हर्ष। इस नाम का इस्लामी संस्कृति में महत्व है, क्योंकि कुरआन में फ़رح के विभिन्न पहलुओं का उल्लेख किया गया है। फ़रहानah भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक लोकप्रिय नाम है, जो सकारात्मक अर्थ और आध्यात्मिक महत्व को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: فرحانہ
in_pashto.meaning: فرحانہ معنی یې د خوښۍ، خوشحالي او خوشۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: فرحانہ د عربي نوم دی چې د فرح فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې خوښۍ، خوشحالي او خوشۍ څرګندوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره سمون لري، او د اسلامي کلتور برخه ده. فرحانہ د پښتنو په منځ کې يو مشهور نوم دی، چې مثبته معنی او روحاني اهميت لري

data.cultural_impact: The name "Farhanah" carries a rich cultural significance, reflecting the deep love and joy that parents feel towards their newborn child. In many Muslim communities, naming ceremonies are celebrated with great importance and excitement, often marked by feasts, gatherings, and gift-giving. Accordingly, the name "Farhanah" is an apt reflection of this joyous occasion, symbolizing the happiness and liveliness associated with the birth of a child. It also reinforces the importance of family and community in Muslim culture, as the name itself suggests that the child will bring happiness to not just her immediate family, but also to the wider community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Farhanah" represents a deeper meaning and significance. It is a reminder of the believer's relationship with God, who is the ultimate source of joy and happiness. In the Quran, Allah says, "And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to mankind and as a giver of glad tidings to those who believe and as a warner to those who do not believe" (21:107). Therefore, the name "Farhanah" can be seen as a reminder of the inherent joy and happiness that comes from believing in and following the teachings of Allah. It is a reminder to the child that her source of true joy and happiness comes from her connection to God, and that she should strive to spread happiness and joy to others as a reflection of the joy and mercy that has been bestowed upon her.
